text.codex.tidewater.title: Tidewater Landing
text.codex.tidewater.text: A ferry town built on pilings. Its noticeboard is the only post office for three bays.
text.codex.bell_warden.title: {name:bell_warden}
text.codex.bell_warden.text: A clockwork keeper wound to guard the cove bell. Nobody remembers who wound it.
text.talk.reeds.1: Every step out here squelches. I am counting them.
text.talk.reeds.2: Count the bites instead. I am the one who has to dress them.
text.talk.chapter_one.1: A bell that rings by itself. I would like to meet whoever pulls the rope.
text.talk.after_bell.1: Supper at the harbor, then. I hear the guide promised.
